description: NaCaAlH₂OF₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.91 Å. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and six F atoms. Both Ca-O bond lengths are 2.54 Å. There are a spread of Ca-F bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.41 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and six F atoms. Both Ca-O bond lengths are 2.50 Å. There are a spread of Ca-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.39 Å. Al is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.87 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two Ca and two H atoms. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Al atom.
